verdict.rationale: Airwallex's own Merchant of Record add-on has Airwallex act as the legal seller and manage sales tax, VAT, and GST compliance for each sale, and it can be enabled without rebuilding the Payments integration. That is first-party automatic tax handling, but it is in beta with limited eligibility and covers digital products only, with physical goods explicitly unsupported. missing for 10: tax calculation for physical goods, general availability beyond beta, a standalone tax calculation/collection capability for merchants selling as themselves (e.g. tax on invoices or subscriptions), detail on how tax is calculated and shown per transaction, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
